description:
The Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Bihar. 

It aims to improve the status of girls in society and promote their education. 

The scheme provides financial assistance to families for the education and marriage of their daughters. 

The benefits include a one-time financial grant for girls who complete their education up to a certain level. 

Eligible beneficiaries are girls who are residents of Bihar and belong to families with an annual income below a specified limit. 

The application process involves filling out an online application form on the official government portal. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Bihar. 

Financial assistance is provided at different stages of education and upon marriage. 

The scheme encourages families to invest in the education of their daughters. 

It also aims to reduce child marriage by providing financial support for education. 

The timeline for disbursement of funds is typically aligned with the completion of educational milestones.
